title: Anta Hong Kong 100 ultra 2026 – UTMB Index race page
claims: The 2026 Hong Kong 100 took place on 24 January 2026 in Hong Kong, China.
UTMB Index records the 2026 race distance as 92.9 km and the elevation gain as 5,073 m.
The men's winner in 2026 was Guidu Qin of China in 8:52:36, followed by Guangfu Meng in 8:58:50 and Guomin Deng in 9:09:48.
The leading two women in 2026 both recorded 10:43:35: Veronika Leng of Slovakia and Hau Ha Thi of Vietnam.
